# hpe_opsramp_metric (Data Source)

Looks up an OpsRamp metric by its exact metric name, for use when authoring `hpe_opsramp_template` metric groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_opsramp_metric" "example" {
  metric_name = "haproxy.denied_resp_rate"
  scope       = "GLOBAL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric_name` (String) The exact metric name to look up (e.g. `system_linux_services_status`).

### Optional

- `client` (String) Optional client (tenant) UUID to query against. Defaults to the provider tenant.
- `scope` (String) Metric scope to search within. Valid values: `GLOBAL`, `SERVICE PROVIDER`, `PARTNER`, `CLIENT`. Defaults to `CLIENT`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the metric.
- `display_name` (String) The display name shown in the UI.
- `group_name` (String) The metric group name this metric belongs to.
- `resource_type` (String) The resource type this metric applies to.
- `status` (String) The metric status (e.g. `active`).
- `type` (String) The metric data type (e.g. `Counter`, `Gauge`).
- `unit` (String) The metric unit (e.g. `%`, `ms`).
- `unit_label` (String) The human-readable unit label.
